data.body:
[P2] Acknowledge successful input delivery before resetting deduplication

With the checked-in local runner, a FLAT parallel using `first_successful()` can finish while a losing branch's wait B remains pending, followed by root wait A. When B completes, this call exports B during a checkpoint-free PENDING resume that skips the completed parallel. `_begin_invocation()` clears `UpdatedOperationIds`, but `_finish_invocation()` never advances `handler_seen_seq`. After A completes, a subsequent step checkpoint returns B again, and the fresh invocation ledger lets both OTel views export its completion again. Pair eager delivery with successful-response acknowledgment of the captured input sequence in the testing runner, preserving newer updates, and add a multi-invocation regression.
